Which statement about the resultant force acting on a moving object must be correct?
A
It is the change in the momentum of the object per unit time.
B
It is the force needed to keep the object moving at constant speed.
C
It is the impulse acting on the object to keep the object moving.
D
It is the largest forward force acting on the object.

options.label: A
options.text: It is the change in the momentum of the object per unit time.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the force needed to keep the object moving at constant speed.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the impulse acting on the object to keep the object moving.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the largest forward force acting on the object.
